summary_en: Wellness Communications will acquire up to 30,000 ordinary shares (0.24% of outstanding shares) for a maximum total of ¥42 million through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 24 to December 30, 2026, to secure shares for a restricted stock award plan approved at the June 2026 shareholder meeting.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 20, 2026, the board of directors of Wellness Communications Corporation resolved to acquire treasury shares pursuant to the company's articles of incorporation and the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 30,000 ordinary shares, representing 0.24% of issued shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥42 million.

The acquisition will be conducted through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 24, 2026 to December 30, 2026. The implied ceiling price is approximately ¥1,400 per share.

The shares acquired will serve as the source of shares to be delivered under the restricted stock award plan approved by shareholders at the June 2026 annual meeting. By using treasury shares instead of issuing new shares, the company aims to avoid dilution of existing shareholders' ownership while promoting value sharing with shareholders and driving sustained enhancement of corporate value.
